pdf-to-markdown.formula:
heading rules (in order):
1. matches ^\d+(\.\d+)+\s → “## ”
2. letters all UPPERCASE, ≥4 letters, ≤90 chars → “## ”
3. ends with “:”, ≤60 chars → “### ”
lists: ^[•\-*–—]\s → “- ” ; ^\d{1,3}[.)]\s → “1. ”
else → paragraph text.
Blank lines separate blocks; 3+ newlines collapse to 2.
